title: Speechius
claim: Product Hunt: Speechius — The teleprompter that actually listens
why_good: Speechius leverages AI to enhance user engagement by adapting the teleprompter's script in real-time based on audience reactions.
value: Content creators and businesses pay for subscriptions to access advanced features, including analytics and personalized script adjustments.
risk: The technology could be seen as a feature rather than a standalone product, risking absorption by larger video conferencing platforms.
